scope: Three fixed completed images selected independently per scene while the full pass was still running; this is not a dataset-wide accuracy or cache audit. source_provenance.scope: CPU checks of existing saved results only; no inference, evaluator, main locks, GPU jobs or GT poses.

fixed_method.ranking: Stable descending coarse_feature*refined_feature*geometry; segmentation score selects external N+1 pool only; same-CAD translation NMS; official instance-count cap.
